name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold development company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos Project located in the Salta and Catamarca provinces of Argentina. The company is progressing through a Definitive Feasibility Study and has received approval under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI). AbraSilver trades on the TSX under 'ABRA' and on the OTCQX as 'ABBRF'.
